paragraphs: He reports Mar Ukva, who reports Shmuel: Rosh Hashanah 22a.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Davidson Rosh Hashanah22a scalar has Tavi son of Mari Tavi reporting Mar Ukva, who reports Shmuel. Here ר״ה is the tractate, not a personal title. Keep Mari and Mar as written, untitled Tavi/Shmuel and the nested reporting direction. The doubled period in כב.. remains in the Hebrew without a printing-history or error claim.
